Talent0_2Ability.name: 炽心
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: 装备导弹时，可使用导弹发动<buf ID=900002>[协力攻击]</buf>，对目标造成<color=#F74848>0.2</color>倍伤害，对其余部位造成主体伤害<color=#F74848>50%</color>的溅射伤害，并对命中的目标添加<buf ID=4008509>[锁定]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>2</color>次

Talent3_5Ability.name: 炽心
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
装备导弹时，可使用导弹发动<buf ID=900002>[协力攻击]</buf>，对目标造成<color=#F74848>0.2</color>倍伤害，对其余部位造成主体伤害<color=#F74848>50%</color>的溅射伤害，并对命中的目标添加<buf ID=4008509>[锁定]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>2</color>次；
双肩同时装备导弹时，<buf ID=900002>[协力攻击]</buf>时发动<buf ID=900097>[双肩协力攻击]</buf>，造成<color=#F74848>2×0.15</color>倍伤害，对其余部位造成主体伤害<color=#F74848>50%</color>的溅射伤害

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

700043.name: Excellent status
700043.SpecificEffects: When self's HP is full, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

400803.name: 制导轰击
400803.describe:
使用导弹攻击最多<color=#F74848>2</color>个目标，最多消耗<color=#F74848>2</color>枚弹药，对命中部位造成<color=#F74848>0.9</color>倍伤害，对其余部位造成主体伤害<color=#F74848>50%</color>的溅射伤害；
双肩都装备导弹才能使用

400804.name: 极速装填
400804.describe: 使导弹的弹数完全回复，使自身获得<color=#F74848>1</color>AP，然后可使用剩余移动力继续行动

400805.name: 弹头切换
400805.describe: 在<buf ID=4008058>[标准模式]</buf>和<buf ID=4008051>[精准模式]</buf>间切换

400806.name: 集火轰击
400806.describe: 使用导弹攻击单个目标，造成<color=#F74848>1.4</color>倍伤害，对其余部位造成主体伤害<color=#F74848>50%</color>的溅射伤害，战前可<buf ID=900014>[瞄准]</buf>；若目标携带<buf ID=4008509>[锁定]</buf>，可使全体友军对目标发动<buf ID=900002>[协力攻击]</buf>，该协力攻击不要求友军拥有协力能力，也不消耗协力次数

400807.name: 自制填弹器
400807.SpecificEffects: 行动开始时，向未在装填中，且弹数更低的导弹装填<color=#F74848>1</color>发弹药

400808.name: 全弹倾泻
400808.describe:
使用导弹发射所有弹药，随机攻击携带<buf ID=4008509>[锁定]</buf>的目标，每枚导弹对命中部位造成<color=#F74848>0.65</color>倍伤害，对其余部位造成主体伤害<color=#F74848>50%</color>的溅射伤害，每发射<color=#F74848>1</color>枚导弹消耗<color=#F74848>1</color>AP，直到弹药用尽或AP消耗完；单个目标最多只能受到<color=#F74848>5</color>次攻击；
双肩都装备导弹才能使用

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

400841.name: 得意杰作1
400841.SpecificEffects: 天赋发动的<buf ID=900002>[协力攻击]</buf>每回合可发动次数<color=#F74848>+1</color>

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

400844.name: 得意杰作2
400844.SpecificEffects: 每回合首位发动主动攻击对战的其余友军，可在首次主动攻击对战后对目标施加<buf ID=4008509>[锁定]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合

400845.name: 得意杰作3
400845.SpecificEffects: 发动天赋的<buf ID=900002>[协力攻击]</buf>时，伤害倍率提升<color=#F74848>0.1</color>

400846.name: 得意杰作4
400846.SpecificEffects: 发动天赋的<buf ID=900002>[协力攻击]</buf>时，自身回复<color=#F74848>1</color>AP，每回合最多生效<color=#F74848>1</color>次
